seo_title: What's in a Wedding Film? How It's Made | Zen Visuals
seo_description: What a wedding film actually includes, from the morning to the dance floor, how long it takes to edit, how the sound is built, and what you receive. By Zen Visuals, Derbyshire.
h1: What's in a wedding film, and how it's made
hero_alt: Close-up of hands showing wedding rings
intro: Couples often ask us what a wedding film actually contains, how it's put together and why it takes weeks to arrive. This is the honest answer, from the morning of your wedding to the moment the file lands in your inbox.

sections.heading: The morning
sections.text: We usually start with both of you getting ready: the dress going on, the suits, the cards and gifts, the nerves. These quiet shots become the opening of the film.

sections.heading: The ceremony
sections.text: With two of us, we film the ceremony from more than one angle, and the sound is cleaned up in the edit so your vows are clear. If you add the full ceremony as its own film, you get every word uncut.

sections.heading: Portraits and the afternoon
sections.text: Twenty minutes of portraits in the best light we can find, then the real material: drinks, laughter, the people you love talking to each other.

sections.heading: Speeches and the evening
sections.text: Speeches are cleaned up in the edit and used throughout the film as the voice of your day. Then the first dance and the dance floor, which is where most films end.

sections.heading: The edit: hours for every minute
sections.text: Back at the desk, everything we filmed is reviewed, the moments chosen, the story built, the colour graded shot by shot and the sound mixed. A four-minute film takes many hours, which is why delivery is three to six weeks.

sections.heading: Sound design you'd only notice if it was gone
sections.text: At the bigger moments we add subtle sound effects beneath the music and real audio: the rustle of the dress, the rings, confetti, champagne. You'll hardly notice them, and you'd miss them if they weren't there.

sections.heading: What you receive
sections.text: A 3–6 minute wedding film to watch, download and share, plus any full ceremony or speech films you've added.

faqs.question: How long does a wedding film take to edit?
faqs.answer: Ours is ready within three to six weeks. Every finished minute takes hours of selecting, cutting, colour grading and sound mixing.

faqs.question: Will we hear our vows and speeches?
faqs.answer: Yes. Vows and speeches are cleaned up and mixed so you hear every word, and they run through the film as the voice of your day.

faqs.question: Can we choose the music?
faqs.answer: We'll talk about the music you love and find something that fits the mood of your day.

faqs.question: Can we get the full ceremony and speeches?
faqs.answer: Yes. They can be added to any film package for £225 and arrive as their own films alongside your wedding film.
